claims.text: Hypovolemic (normal adrenal function): 0.9% saline usually corrects both the hyponatremia and the hypovolemia
claims.quote: In patients with hypovolemia and normal adrenal function, administration of 0.9% saline usually corrects both hyponatremia and hypovolemia.

claims.text: Severe, rapid-onset or highly symptomatic: partial rapid correction w hypertonic (3%) saline
claims.quote: In severe, rapid onset or highly symptomatic hyponatremia, partial rapid correction with hypertonic (3%) saline

claims.text: Raise Na no more than 8 mEq/L over the first 24 h;
claims.quote: Should not be increased by more than 8 mEq/L (8 mmol/L) over the first 24 hours

claims.text: too-rapid correction can cause osmotic demyelination syndrome
claims.quote: too-rapid correction of hyponatremia can cause neurologic complications, such as osmotic demyelination syndrome.
